cutsceneModel.notes: A cutscene is normal gameplay with scripted control layered on top. Dialogue uses the ordinary gameplay dialogue UI, automatically swaps the active speaker from line metadata, never moves the player unless a beat explicitly asks for it, and never makes NPCs face/headtrack the player unless authored.

rescue.title: Prologue — The Rescue

dialogueTest.purpose: Verify that one gameplay dialogue sequence automatically retargets name, portrait, and camera from Jubmir to Spearhead and back without moving the player or forcing NPC headtracking.

rescue.notes: Loads a dedicated authored 25x25 exterior clearing. The central 15x15 is walkable; the surrounding five-tile frame is solid Cloud Forest underbrush and the outermost ring receives generated Shadewood trees. Southern Cloud Forest scene fog plus its player-centered cloud-fog runtime remain active here. Normal wilderness population is suppressed because this is a scripted prologue set, not a sandbox wilderness zone. Startup loading is held until this exact 25x25 scene is built, decorated, and has rendered two frames. The current dialogue lines are explicit temporary target-test copy, not final prologue writing.

hunundi_room.title: Prologue — Father Hunundi's Room
hunundi_room.notes: Loads Father Hunundi's existing authored room through the ordinary building/interior runtime. Dialogue is intentionally empty during the map-flow pass.
